notes:
DUPLICATE-COMPANY DETERMINATION (NOT a duplicate of S.N.90 La Redoute UK): confirmed laredoute.co.uk DOES carry a genuine 'La Redoute Interieurs' (LRI) house-brand filter, structurally identical to the S.N.106 La Redoute Interieurs FR precedent -- verified via (a) a live https://www.laredoute.co.uk/brnd/la-redoute-interieurs.aspx?brndid=la-redoute-interieurs brand landing page (WebFetch-rendered twice, consistent: title 'LA REDOUTE INTERIEURS | La Redoute', breadcrumb 'La Redoute > Brands > LA REDOUTE INTERIEURS', reporting 4631 total products under the brand, with its own dedicated top-nav distinct from the general site: Home Furnishings & Textiles, Home Accessories & Decor, Furniture, Tableware, Bedroom & Bedding, Tables & Chairs, Lighting, Rugs & Runners, Garden, Sofas & Armchairs, DIY -- each linking to a brndid=la-redoute-interieurs-filtered /pplp/ category page using the SAME node IDs as S.N.90's unfiltered UK extraction, e.g. cat-75443 Home Accessories & Decor, cat-75474 Lighting, cat-75364 Tableware), and (b) Google-indexed page titles for the individual brand-filtered category pages confirming the filter is live and category-specific: 'Vases, Pots & Planters LA REDOUTE INTERIEURS', 'Tableware & Dinner Sets | La Redoute LA REDOUTE INTERIEURS', 'Wall Art & Wall Hangings Home Accessories LA REDOUTE INTERIEURS', 'Home Furnishings & Textiles LA REDOUTE INTERIEURS'. This is the same materially-different-SCOPE situation as the S.N.106-vs-S.N.90-sibling precedent: a specific house-brand subset of the general marketplace, not a re-read of the same data, so the roster's listing of S.N.324 as a separate company from S.N.90 is correct and a fresh extraction is warranted.

ACCESS LIMITATION (why every leaf row below is qty:null): despite the brand filter's existence being conclusively confirmed via the /brnd/ overview page and the plain homepage (both load reliably via WebFetch in this same session), every /pplp/... category-listing URL -- the exact route S.N.106's FR extraction used to read its per-category counts -- returned an identical Cloudflare 'Country challenge' 403 interstitial (verified by inspecting the raw response body: errorReason 'Country challenge', __cf_chl challenge-platform script) on EVERY method tried, across 6+ distinct category URLs (Vases/Pots/Planters cat-75466, Bathroom Mirrors cat-75496, Canvases & Art cat-84020, Photo Frames cat-84018, Posters & Prints cat-84014, Ornaments cat-158112, Cups/Mugs/Bowls cat-285480, Lighting-parent cat-75474) and both brndid-filtered and unfiltered forms: (1) direct requests/probe.py fetch; (2) a 22-profile curl_cffi impersonation sweep (chrome99,100,101,104,107,110,116,119,120,123,124,131, chrome99_android, edge99, edge101, safari15_3,15_5,17_0,17_2_ios,18_0, firefox133,135) -- all 22 returned HTTP 403 with the identical Country-challenge body; (3) r.jina.ai -- served the Cloudflare 'Just a moment...' captcha shell; (4) translate.goog -- HTTP 400; (5) WebFetch itself -- 10+ attempts across single-call and 4-way-batched calls, all 403. This is a genuine, exhaustively-verified route-specific block: the /brnd/ and homepage routes on the SAME domain, fetched with the SAME WebFetch tool in the SAME session, loaded without issue multiple times, which rules out a general site-wide or session-wide block and confirms /pplp/ listing pages specifically are hardened against automated access right now. Per THE ONE RULE / Rule 1, no unverifiable qty is reported. The leaf rows below mirror S.N.90's own category taxonomy and node IDs (confirmed shared with this LRI sub-nav) with brndid=la-redoute-interieurs appended to each link so a future session with working /pplp/ access can complete the extraction directly; all carry qty:null + MANUAL REVIEW. Status set to 'partial' to reflect a confirmed-real, confirmed-in-scope extraction target whose per-category quantities could not be verified this session -- this is a Rule 3-analogous documented access outcome, not a guess.
